name: Control transfers retain target result and error rules

input.fixture_ref: Audit IRIS-V1-CONTROL-C049 and C068 control-transfer table rows and their future cross-links.

applicability.reason: Requires cross-linking the mandated control-transfer tables. Break with a value, bare break and loop results all behave correctly, but the row asserts that EVERY transfer has target, result and error rules stated in those tables, which is a property of the specification text rather than of any program.

expect.status: Every control transfer has target, result, and error rules in the mandated tables.
